pr_title: copilot: Add support for new models
pr_body:
Closes #19963

This PR implements integration with the newly announced GitHub Copilot LLM models, including:
- Claude 3.5 Sonnet
- o1-mini
- o1-preview

Release Notes:

- N/A

Do this update also supports the copilot custom instructions?

> Do this update also supports the copilot custom instructions? No. Please open a distinct issue for supporting `.github/copilot-instructions.md` files. Zed does allow controlling the prompts used in the Assistant Panel (`assistant: deploy prompt library` from the command palette). Additionally, although there is no GUI, Zed also supports defining custom templates for other prompts by editing a few configuration files. See: https://zed.dev/docs/assistant/prompting#advanced-concepts
